title: Self-Pay Charge for Uncovered Rental Days on Insurance Rentals (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Customer terms.** Under Rental Vehicle Coordination, when a renter on an insurance rental asks to settle the rental days no insurer or network authorization covers, the desk works out the self-pay charge and the renter authorizes it on their own rental; it is booked as one uncovered-days customer charge on the final invoice of the returned rental.

The self-pay charge is fixed only after the days the network's own calibration trouble cost the repair stand on the reservation as network courtesy days.

A self-pay charge is not booked until every extension the insurer approved on the reservation stands as authorized days.

## Business effect

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Request it answers | A renter on an insurance rental asking to settle the rental days no insurer or network authorization covers |
| Who works it out and who authorizes it | The desk works out the self-pay charge; the renter authorizes it on their own rental |
| Observable effect | One customer charge of kind uncovered days appears on the final invoice of the returned rental in the rental's day and money history, dated the day it is authorized, for the self-pay days it covers; the renter's outstanding share rises by its amount |

## Authorization tool: `authorize_self_pay_days_charge_125d1a79`

**Capability.** Lets the renter authorize, on their own returned insurance rental, the charge for the rental days no insurer or network authorization covers. Authorizing posts one customer charge of kind `uncovered_days` on the final invoice, dated today, for the days and amount given; the renter's outstanding share rises by that amount.

**How it is invoked.** This tool belongs to the customer: the desk unlocks `authorize_self_pay_days_charge_125d1a79` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to authorize the charge on their rental.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_reservation_id` | Reference number of the renter's rental reservation, as read out by the desk from the rental reservation lookup | Id |
| `days_count` | Self-pay rental days the charge covers | Integer count of rental days |
| `amount_usd` | Self-pay charge amount | USD, 2 decimal places, positive; rounded half-up to the cent when posted |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` ("authorized" when the charge was posted), `rental_entry_id` (reference number of the new charge entry), `rental_reservation_id` (the reservation charged), `charge_type` (always "uncovered_days"), `settlement_kind` (always "final"), `days_count` (integer days covered), `amount_usd` (the amount charged, USD with 2 decimal places) and `entry_date` (posting date, YYYY-MM-DD).

## Contract illustration (hypothetical)

When the customer themselves runs the tool with their reservation reference, a `days_count` of 4 and an `amount_usd` of 211.96, the receipt reads `status` "authorized", `charge_type` "uncovered_days" and `settlement_kind` "final".
